subject: general
question: The famous explorer _________ wanted to come to India, but instead landed on the shores of America.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Christopher Columbus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Christopher Columbus **was an **Italian explorer **and **navigator**.
 
• He was **born **in **1451 **and **died in 1506**.
 
• He is known for **his 1492 'discovery' **of the **New World of the Americas **on **board **his **ship Santa Maria**.
 
• **Columbus **wanted to **find **a **new route to India**, **China**, **Japan **and the **Spice Islands**.
 
• The **faous explorer Christopher Columbus **wanted to **come **to **Indial **but **instead landed **on **the shores of America**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Genghis Khan **was the **founder **and **first Great Khan **of the **Mongol Empire**, which became **the largest contiguous empire **in **history after his death**.
 
• **Vasco da Gama **was best known for **being the first to sail **from **Europe to India **by **rounding Africa's Cape **of **Good Hope**.
 
• **Alexander **is known as **'the great**' both for **his military genius **and his **diplomatic skills **in handling the various **populaces of the regions he conquered**.
